name: Waka
source:
A mysterious girl that works for the student council. She loves milk tea, a lot. She even has a song about it.

[From [url=http://www.neechin.net/article/128/kitto-sumiwataru-asairo-yori-mo-review]Agilis' review[/url].]

[spoiler]Her real name is Tsune Wakamaru (経若丸), daughter of Kureha (Momiji) and granddaughter of Sasamaru and Kikuyo[/spoiler]
